text: 中国上市公司协会发布6月统计月报。数据显示，截至2026年6月30日，境内股票市场共有上市公司5535家，沪、深、北证券交易所分别为2314家、2898家、323家。分股份类型看，仅发A股公司5263家，A+H、A+B等多股份类型公司265家，仅发B股公司7家。
text_en: China Association for Public Companies released its June statistical monthly report. Data shows that as of June 30, 2026, there were 5,535 listed companies in the domestic stock market, with 2,314 on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, 2,898 on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, and 323 on the Beijing Stock Exchange. By share type, there were 5,263 companies issuing only A-shares, 265 companies with multi-share types such as A+H or A+B, and 7 companies issuing only B-shares.
